marketHelp._comment: EDITABLE: shown when a user taps the (i) button on a market selection. Placeholders: {pick} = selected outcome, {home} = home team, {away} = away team, {line} = goals line (may be empty), {lineText} = ' (line X)' or empty.

MATCH_WINNER.title: Match Winner — {pick}
MATCH_WINNER.body: You win if {pick} wins the match at full time (90 minutes plus stoppage time; extra time does not count unless stated). If the match ends in a draw, or any other team wins, this pick loses.

MATCH_WINNER_DRAW.title: Match Winner — Draw
MATCH_WINNER_DRAW.body: You win if {home} vs {away} ends in a draw at full time (90 minutes plus stoppage time). If either team wins, this pick loses.

DRAW_NO_BET.title: Draw No Bet — {pick}
DRAW_NO_BET.body: You win if {pick} wins the match at full time. If the match ends in a draw, your stake is returned (no win, no loss). Any other result loses.

DOUBLE_CHANCE.title: Double Chance — {pick}
DOUBLE_CHANCE.body: You win if EITHER of the two outcomes in '{pick}' happens at full time. Only the remaining outcome makes this pick lose. Odds are lower because two results win.

FIRST_HALF_WINNER.title: First Half Winner — {pick}
FIRST_HALF_WINNER.body: You win if {pick} is leading at half time (first 45 minutes plus stoppage time). Only the first-half score counts — the final result does not matter.

SECOND_HALF_WINNER.title: Second Half Winner — {pick}
SECOND_HALF_WINNER.body: You win if {pick} scores more goals than the opponent in the second half alone (45-90 minutes plus stoppage time). Only second-half goals count.

OVER_UNDER.title: Total Goals{lineText} — {pick}
OVER_UNDER.body: You win if the total goals in the match at full time are {pick} {line}. Example: Over 2.5 wins with 3+ goals; Under 2.5 wins with 0, 1 or 2 goals. Extra time does not count.

OVER_UNDER_H1.title: First Half Goals{lineText} — {pick}
OVER_UNDER_H1.body: You win if the total goals in the FIRST HALF are {pick} {line}. Only first-half goals count.

OVER_UNDER_H2.title: Second Half Goals{lineText} — {pick}
OVER_UNDER_H2.body: You win if the total goals in the SECOND HALF are {pick} {line}. Only second-half goals count.

TEAM_TOTALS.title: Team Goals{lineText} — {pick}
TEAM_TOTALS.body: You win if the goals scored by the named team at full time are {pick} {line}. Only that team's goals count.

HANDICAP.title: Handicap{lineText} — {pick}
HANDICAP.body: The handicap {line} is added to {pick}'s goals before comparing. You win if {pick} still leads after the adjustment at full time. A negative line (e.g. -1.5) means they must win by more.

BTTS.title: Both Teams To Score — {pick}
BTTS.body: 'Yes' wins if BOTH {home} and {away} score at least one goal at full time. 'No' wins if at least one team fails to score. The winner of the match does not matter.

BTTS_H1.title: First Half BTTS — {pick}
BTTS_H1.body: Same as Both Teams To Score, but only first-half goals count. 'Yes' needs both teams to score before half time.

CORRECT_SCORE.title: Correct Score — {pick}
CORRECT_SCORE.body: You win ONLY if the match ends at full time with exactly the score '{pick}' (home goals - away goals). Any other score loses, even if your team wins.

CORRECT_SCORE_H1.title: Half Time Score — {pick}
CORRECT_SCORE_H1.body: You win ONLY if the half-time score is exactly '{pick}'. Any other half-time score loses.

HTFT.title: Half-Time / Full-Time — {pick}
HTFT.body: You win if the half-time result AND the full-time result both match '{pick}' (e.g. Home/Home means the home team leads at half time AND wins the match). Both parts must be right.

OUTRIGHT.title: Outright — {pick}
OUTRIGHT.body: You win if {pick} wins the whole competition/tournament, not just one match. Settled when the competition ends.

PLAYER_PROP.title: Player Special — {pick}
PLAYER_PROP.body: A bet on an individual player's performance (goals, cards, etc.). You win if the named player hits the stated target. If the player does not play, the pick is usually voided.

CUSTOM.title: {pick}
CUSTOM.body: A special market. You win if the event described in '{pick}' happens as stated. Check the market name for the exact condition.

DEFAULT.title: {pick}
DEFAULT.body: You win if the outcome '{pick}' happens under this market's rules at the stated period of the game.
